text:
Quinn (People Ops): All-hands next Thu 9:30am PT (HQ + Zoom). Short agenda and two asks below — please add Qs here or anonymously: https://forms.redwood.internal/ah-quickq (closes Wed 5pm).

Quinn (People Ops): Agenda (24m):
• 8m — Exec snapshot & hiring focus (Zoe)
• 6m — Playbook launch: checklist & KPIs (Nikhil)
• 4m — Runtime perf highlight + canary plan (Rae)
• 3m — Security note: logs retention proposal + migration path (Ada)
• 2m — GTM: partner mention + renewals heads-up (Miro)
• 1-?m — Rapid Q&A (may run a few extra minutes)

Quinn (People Ops): Asks: 1) Upload slides to drive.redwood.internal/allhands/thu-9-30 by Wed 3pm. 2) If you demo, post 1-line blurb + infra needs (GPU, demo tenant, etc.).

Zoe (CEO): I'll open with a short runway/metrics snapshot and one ask for leaders: name one cross-team blocker and one recent win. Keep it brief.

Nikhil (Product): We'll present the launch playbook and success checklist. Requesting 2 slides; will paste the playbook link in chat during the call.

Rae (Eng): Eng wants to show a 30s clip of the KV-prefetch improvement (~12% p99). Need co-host for demo. Pre-recorded clip available.

Ada (Security): Heads-up: proposing internal debug logs retention change (90d → 45d) to reduce storage costs. This does not change Dedicated customer defaults. I'll share a scoped impact doc in my slot and migration steps for teams with long-lived buckets.

Miro (GTM): We'll add a 15s partner shout and ask RevOps for an FAQ draft for CSMs on upcoming bundle updates.

Quinn (People Ops): Logistics: recording + captions posted to #all-hands-recordings within 24h. If you want specific clips, DM me timestamps after the meeting. Also — presenters, please confirm if you need co-host rights.

Nikhil (Product): Suggest adding a 20s customer quote after product slides. If you have one, paste it here and we'll include.

Miro (GTM): Pasting a short beta quote from Customer Z now.

Rae (Eng): Quick ask — can we get the Zoom link pinned in the calendar invite and presenter perms set?

Calendar Bot: Event updated: "All-Hands — Launch Playbook & Ops" Thu 09:30 PT — Zoom link pinned.

Ada (Security): Small note/question: will this retention change affect internal alerts? Short answer: alerts unaffected, but teams using logs for ad-hoc long-term debugging should review the migration doc.

Quinn (People Ops): Thanks all — final reminder to keep updates to 1-2 slides / 90s so Q&A fits. Drop a confirmation once slides are uploaded. :calendar:
